dogecoin.text: The war between #Bitcoin and #dogecoin is EXACTLY why we can’t have nice things.

I think we are in the era of crypto civil war. We should calm the F down, #Bitcoin and #dogecoin supporters. This war will end hurting all cryptos alike on both sides, and we all know who wins if we all lose. @elonmusk the technoking you are, you rise above these in fightings. 🖖
